Lazy data frame columns

Source: R/lazy-columns.R
lazy-columns.Rd

The columns of a lazy obs or var (see lazy-dataframe):

  • plain numeric, bool and string columns are 1-d DelayedArrays over a StoreDenseSeed (see lazy-dense)

  • a LazyCategorical holds a 1-d DelayedArray of codes and the categories (read at once, as they are small)

  • a LazyNullable holds 1-d DelayedArrays of values and mask

Usage

# S4 method for class 'LazyCategorical'
length(x)

# S4 method for class 'LazyNullable'
length(x)

# S4 method for class 'LazyCategorical,ANY,ANY,ANY'
x[i, j, ..., drop = TRUE]

# S4 method for class 'LazyNullable,ANY,ANY,ANY'
x[i, j, ..., drop = TRUE]

# S4 method for class 'LazyCategorical'
as.vector(x, mode = "any")

# S4 method for class 'LazyNullable'
as.vector(x, mode = "any")

# S4 method for class 'LazyCategorical'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, ...)

# S4 method for class 'LazyNullable'
as.data.frame(x, row.names = NULL, optional = FALSE, ...)

# S4 method for class 'LazyCategorical'
show(object)

# S4 method for class 'LazyNullable'
show(object)

# S4 method for class 'LazyCategorical'
showAsCell(object)

# S4 method for class 'LazyNullable'
showAsCell(object)

lazy_column(store, path, call = rlang::caller_env())

Arguments

x

A lazy column.

i

Positions to keep.

j, drop, ...

Not used.

mode

Not used.

object

A lazy column.

store

An open store handle, see io-store.

path

Absolute path of the Element of the column.

call

The call reported by errors.

Details

The two classes define length(), [, show(), as.vector() and as.data.frame(), so they subset, print and realise inside a DataFrame. [ stays lazy and realising gives exactly what read_h5ad()/read_zarr() give for the same Element: the factor with its categories attribute, the value with NA and the nullable record, the On-disk dtype record.
